prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Edit target Image 1 is our title background. Supporting reference Image 2 is the actual in-game office (visual simplicity), Image 3 is our corporate poster sheet (flat graphic design language), Image 4 is our HUD mockup (badge and clock layout), Image 5 is our existing original fictional HALCYON logo (exact brand reference).
Create revision 02 of the same 16:9 title background, desired 1920x1080. Preserve the composition: office cubicles on left, big clear central wall/aisle, desk lower right with badge 4471, mint mug, keyboard, empty director chair at right midground and tiny distant red recording light. Keep mint #7FD3C4, sky blue #A7C7F2, pale grey, off-white and blue-grey.
RESTYLE THE WHOLE ROOM to match flat corporate illustration from poster reference: solid colour planes, simplified low-poly geometry, sharply controlled edges, minimal soft shadows, almost no surface grain or realistic wood/carpet, no photoreal reflections. Plants become simplified angular leaves; desk has a plain pale wood colour plane. Sophisticated flat editorial game art, still the same perspective space. Preserve a dark muted central wall sufficient for bright live menu text.
MUG: print the provided HALCYON half-sun horizon mark and dark HALCYON wordmark on its front facing camera, brand reference 5. On the mint mug use off-white half-sun and dark blue-grey wordmark, clean proportionate print, not a floating logo. Only 'HALCYON', omit tiny CONTINUITY on mug.
HUD DETAILS: tasteful compact corporate identity card anchored upper-left within safe margins, off-white rectangle with mint header strip and simple silhouette avatar, clean sans-serif text exactly 'HALCYON' header, 'EMPLOYEE 4471', small subline 'CONTINUITY ASSOCIATE', then three small outlined pass slots labelled '01' '02' '03'. Keep card narrow, under 23% image width and under 25% height. Upper-right: compact dark blue-grey bold digital time '08:59' and small 'TAKE 01', matching graphic restraint of HUD reference. Lower-left: tiny film-recording corner bracket and a muted red indicator dot, no other text. HUD should look like designed screen graphics, not physical signs in room. NO task list or interaction prompt, no giant game title, no start/settings labels. Keep centre x30%-70%, y28%-78% free of HUD for live title/menu later. Do not fill blank wall with posters or logos. No real brands, no watermark. Flat illustration with HUD corner accents.
input_roles: poster sheet: corporate flat design language
HALCYON logo: existing fictional company brand
